title: #4 on Python-PPTX arena and #5 on Spreadsheet arena. Thanks! @DesignArena
text: #4 on Python-PPTX arena and #5 on Spreadsheet arena. Thanks! @DesignArena DesignArena@DesignArena BREAKING: Qwen4-Max by @Alibaba_Qwen ranks #4 on Python-PPTX arena with an Elo rating of 1302 and #5 on Spreadsheet arena with an Elo rating of 1336. On Spreadsheet arena, this marks a 30-position jump from Qwen’s previous model, Qwen 3.7 Max, and a 379-point Elo increase. On Python-PPTX arena, this marks a 5-position jump from its previous model and an 80-point Elo increase. This also places it in the same performance band as top models from @AnthropicAI, @OpenAI, and @Kimi_Moonshot. Congrats to the @Alibaba_Qwen team on placing top-5 on both leaderboards! 🔗 View Quoted Tweet 💬12🔄17❤️385👀33522📊42 ⚡ Powered by xgo.ing
